examples.before:
model: opus
temperature: 0.2  # same-size edits below
agents:
  coder: file:agents/coder.yaml
limits: file:limits.yaml
examples.input: `config watch` running; edit `.troupe/troupe.yml` by hand to change `temperature: 0.2` to `temperature: 0.3` (same file size), then run `config history`

results.1: All six arms: the edit is caught. History entry 6 is `"op": "set", "path": "temperature", "old": 0.2, "new": 0.3, "via": "file"`. Watch prints nothing about the change.

examples.input: `config watch` running; edit `.troupe/limits.yaml` by hand to change `max_tokens: 1000` to `max_tokens: 2000` (a file pulled in through `limits: file:limits.yaml`)

results.1: All six arms: the edit is caught. History entry 7 is `"path": "limits.max_tokens", "old": 1000, "new": 2000, "via": "file"`.

examples.input: `config watch` running; save `.troupe/troupe.yml` again with exactly the content it already has

results.1: All six arms: no history entry is added. The history has only the 5 import entries plus the two real changes.

Four arms: exit 0 on Ctrl-C. Two arms: exit 137, meaning they did not stop on Ctrl-C and had to be killed. In every arm the only output is the start line. Four arms print `watching /theatre` (absolute path) and two print `watching .`; this split does not match the Ctrl-C split.

context.in_practice: The test also tried to repoint the symlink `.troupe/agents/coder.yaml` from `coder-v1.yaml` to `coder-v2.yaml`. The harness's own symlink step failed with exit 1 (".troupe/agents/coder.yaml already exists"), so the link never changed. As a result, no arm recorded a change to `agents.coder.retries`, and the results say nothing about whether watch notices a symlink being repointed.
context.stakes: With `config watch` running, a hand edit to the config files should show up in the history as a change, even when the edit keeps the file the same size. The watcher should also stop cleanly when you press Ctrl-C.
context.tradeoff: Route 1 needs no extra library and catches same-size edits, at the cost of rereading every watched file every 0.1–0.25 s.

plan_why: While watch runs, four kinds of change are made: a same-size in-place edit of troupe.yml, a replace-by-new-file (a symlinked include re-pointed to a newly written file), a touch that rewrites identical bytes, and an edit to a plain included file. After stopping watch, history shows which of these became 'file' events and that the touch produced none.
routes: Poll file bytes with the stdlib every 0.1-0.25 s; no watcher library, no mtime
